title: SQL Injection in User Search
diff:
diff --git a/services/user_service.py b/services/user_service.py
--- a/services/user_service.py
+++ b/services/user_service.py
@@ -12,3 +12,4 @@ def get_user_by_email(email: str):
     cursor = db.cursor()
-    return cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = %s", (email,)).fetchone()
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'"
+    return cursor.execute(query).fetchone()

title: SQL Injection via fmt.Sprintf in User Query
diff:
diff --git a/store/users.go b/store/users.go
--- a/store/users.go
+++ b/store/users.go
@@ -15,3 +15,4 @@ func FindUser(db *sql.DB, username string) (*User, error) {
-    row := db.QueryRow("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = $1", username)
+    query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = '%s'", username)
+    row := db.QueryRow(query)
